source.name: Level 5: 1.3 Test Your Knowledge - Search Command Generator Commands
source.instructions: Why does Rasa recommend Milvus or Qdrant vector stores for production instead of FAISS?

answers.answer: FAISS requires an external API key to run
FAISS is an in-memory local index intended for development, not production workloads
FAISS only supports Extractive search, not Generative search

source.guidance: FAISS runs as a local in-memory index, which makes it simple to use during development with no external service needed. For production, Rasa recommends Milvus or Qdrant vector databases, which are designed for production-scale workloads.
